about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.

mutants.name: d1-filtermap-keeps-last
mutants.from:
case Some[U] as s:
			out = out.Append(s.Value)
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: FilterMap keeps the value of every Some, in order.

mutants.name: d1-any-never
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: Any reports whether accept takes some element.

mutants.name: d1-partition-swapped
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: Partition puts the kept first.

mutants.name: d1-dedupe-keeps-all
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: Dedupe keeps each element once, at its first occurrence.

mutants.name: d1-chunks-one-long
mutants.from: let size = if n < 1 { 1 } else { n }
mutants.to: let size = if n < 1 { 1 } else { n + 1 }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: Chunks holds n elements in each chunk but the last.

mutants.name: d1-windows-one-short
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: Windows is len(xs) - n + 1 runs.

mutants.name: d1-groupby-overwrites
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: GroupBy keeps every element of a group, in the order of xs.

mutants.name: d1-zip-one-short

		out = out.Append((a[i], b[i]))
mutants.to:
for i in 1..n {
		out = out.Append((a[i], b[i]))
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 11: Zip holds as many pairs as the shorter slice, from index 0.

mutants.name: d1-entries-unsorted
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 12: Entries is in ascending key order.

mutants.name: d1-difference-is-intersection
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 13: Difference is the keys in a and not in b.

mutants.name: d1-remove-keeps
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices, maps and cmp 13: Remove is s without k.

mutants.name: d2-add-no-carry
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 2: Add is exact: the low half's carry reaches the high half.

mutants.name: d2-sub-no-borrow
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 2: Sub is exact: the low half's borrow reaches the high half.

mutants.name: d2-mul-cross-dropped
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 2: Mul is exact: both cross products reach the high half.

mutants.name: d2-mul-overflow-missed
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 2: A product over 128 bits is Overflow, never wrapped.

mutants.name: d2-divmod-no-correction
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 3: Div's quotient by a divisor over 64 bits is exact after its one correction.

mutants.name: d2-halfeven-as-halfup
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 3: HalfEven rounds a tie to the even neighbour.

mutants.name: d2-halfup-tie-down
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 3: HalfUp rounds a tie away from zero.

mutants.name: d2-floor-as-down
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 3: Floor rounds toward negative infinity.

mutants.name: d2-div-big-half-ignored
mutants.from: let half = if k > MaxScale() { -1 } else { halfOf(a.coef, b.coef, k) }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 3: Div by a divisor past 128 bits still rounds against half of it.

mutants.name: d2-cmp-sign-flip
mutants.from: if sa < 0 { cmp128(y, x) } else { cmp128(x, y) }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 2: Cmp compares the numbers, a negative pair by the larger magnitude below.

mutants.name: d2-add-wrong-sign
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 2: Add of opposite signs takes the sign of the larger magnitude.

mutants.name: d2-text-no-pad
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 4: Text writes a 0 before the point of a value under 1.

mutants.name: d2-text-low-unpadded
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 4: Text writes every digit of a coefficient over 64 bits.

mutants.name: d2-parse-trailing-point
mutants.rule: stdlib.md decimal 4: Parse refuses a point with no digit after it.
